description: Bottom-sheet drawer component built on Vaul. Slides up from the bottom of the screen and supports drag-to-close gestures. Composed of Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerPortal, DrawerOverlay, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader, DrawerFooter, DrawerTitle, DrawerDescription, and DrawerClose.
useCases: Mobile-friendly survey action sheets for editing, sharing, or deleting
Step-by-step configuration panels that slide up from the bottom on smaller screens
Quick-access filter and sort panels in analytics dashboards
Goal or value input panels with numeric controls (e.g., daily activity targets)
